source_conform_notes.V01: The ~large rendition is 30.000 fps and must be conformed to 30000/1001 without duplicated or dropped frames; the ~orig rendition is 23.976 fps and needs motion-aware conversion. Embedded archival film segments are 4:3 pillarboxed inside the 16:9 frame; do not crop or stretch them further.
source_conform_notes.stills: Stills are of mixed resolution (479x450 up to 15761x9328). Scale with a high-quality resampler; no stretching; pan/scan moves permitted.

archival_sd_policy.frame_rate_conversion: motion-compensated or blend; naive frame duplication penalized

audio.embedded_source_audio_policy: Period launch audio and 1965 narration from V01 may be used as sound bites; level-match them to the narration anchor within 3 LU. No music under them while audible.
audio.narration_stem_policy: A2: narration rendered with provided voice A01; declared alternative TTS permitted, must be listed in manifest.json
